title: Then and now photo cards
subject: History
unit: Summer 1: How our street has changed (Street Detectives)
source: Seeded from history/y2 lesson 10 (Then and now photo cards (portal printable; objects and streets, no people))
intro: Lesson 10: How has our street changed?. To understand that streets have changed within living memory and how to find out by asking questions

cards:
living memory
the past that people alive
today remember

past
a time that has gone

source
something that tells us about
the past
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Is a mobile phone then or now?
questions.model: Grandparents did not have mobile phones as children. We have them now. So it is now.

questions.q: Who could you ask about the past?
questions.a: A grandparent, older neighbour or older relative

questions.q: Is a telephone box a source?
questions.a: Yes, it tells us how people used to call

questions.q: Write three questions to ask an older relative about their street when they were young.
questions.a: For example: What shops were there? How did you get to school? Were there many cars?
questions.model: Teacher writes the first question: 'What shops were on your street?'

questions.q: Write one thing you think has changed and why.
questions.a: For example: more cars, because more families have one now

questions.q: What do you think has stayed the same?
questions.a: For example: post boxes, houses, the mosque

questions.q: Big question: what would your grandparents notice is different?
questions.a: For example: more cars, mobile phones, new shops
